name: zero-slop
description: Turns AI-sounding drafts into professionally copy-edited expert prose and proves it: transparent surface scorer, evidence-ranked rewrite ladder, quantitative verify gate, and private online learning.

interface.shortDescription: Remove AI-sounding prose. Keep every fact. Verify the result.
interface.longDescription: A de-slop skill with a quantitative gate: it measures a draft with an interpretable heuristic surface score, rewrites it in two passes, uses a dedicated copy desk and final read-aloud editor, verifies the exact finished text, and learns from later human edits through a private evidence-gated overlay. Draft scoring stays local and dependency-free; the optional release check sends only a version query.
